title: Resolve legacy channel identities before canonical migration
description: Development contains legacy channel identities that cannot be migrated automatically without data loss or an explicit product decision. Audit evidence on 2026-09-09: 180 legacy channel rows; 178 one-human/one-bot direct candidates; 0 multi-bot named candidates; 2 human-only invalid empty channels; and one duplicate direct identity for AcceptLoopBot spanning 5 channels and 12 messages total. Resolve the two invalid channels and choose/preserve the canonical AcceptLoopBot history before applying the one-path channel migration. No migration has been applied. This blocks deployment of the canonical channel reader.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Audit source is the development channel table on 2026-09-09. No migration was applied during the audit. Keep this issue open until the 2 human-only empty channels and the AcceptLoopBot duplicate identity are resolved, the migration is applied once, and the canonical reader can deploy without losing or orphaning history.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Resolved in development on 2026-09-10. Applied the canonical migration to all 180 legacy rows. The two verified-empty human-only identities were removed. All 12 AcceptLoopBot messages were preserved and resequenced in canonical channel e48d45e4-cdd9-4c7f-af31-0927042d1c23; its metadata is kind=direct, next_seq=13, and message count=12. A post-migration audit returned zero legacy, invalid, or duplicate-direct groups.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Canonical migration applied and verified without transcript loss.
